en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, from Safwan Bin yahya, from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajjaj, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘A limit of the one who despairs from the menstruation (Haydh) is fifty years (of age)’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn ’Isma‘il has narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Safwan ibn Yahya from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Menopause happens at the age of fifty years.”’
